The '''Protector''' was a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] revolver produced by [[Barimoq Industries]]. With a range of fifty-five meters and a capacity of five slugs, the Protector was a reliable weapon, though, was crude and unrefined like most [[Tasari]] slugthrowers. Because of the low level of technology of [[Tasariq]], the Protector lagged behind the galactic standard of most "modern" slugthrowers and lacked the punch of comparable slugthrowers. This severely limited its ability to damage heavy armor; though the weapon remained deadly to medium and lighter armors.<ref name="J15" />
